```{r scratch-viz-setup, include=FALSE}
# Publication figure system: house theme, validated colour-vision-safe palette,
# and vector (PDF) output alongside every raster figure. Applied globally, so
# the plotting code below needs no changes. Guarded: if the library is not
# staged, the notebook renders exactly as it did before.
local({
  roots <- c(".", "assets/viz", Sys.getenv("SCRATCH_VIZ_DIR", "."))
  for (lib in c("scratch_viz.R", "scratch_report.R")) {
    for (r in roots) {
      p <- file.path(r, lib)
      if (file.exists(p)) { source(p, local = FALSE); break }
    }
  }
})
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(knitr)
})

if (!is.null(params$work_directory) && dir.exists(params$work_directory)) {
  setwd(params$work_directory)
}

inputs <- params$inputs_dir

read_json_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(fromJSON(p), error = function(e) NULL)
}
find_files <- function(sub, pattern) {
  d <- file.path(inputs, sub)
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(character(0))
  list.files(d, pattern = pattern, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
}

manifest <- read_json_safe(file.path(inputs, "manifest", "run_manifest.json"))
if (is.null(manifest)) {
  mf <- find_files("manifest", "run_manifest\\.json$")
  if (length(mf)) manifest <- read_json_safe(mf[1])
}

trace_file <- find_files("manifest", "^trace\\.csv$")
cross_csv  <- find_files("cross", "\\.csv$")
reports    <- find_files("reports", "\\.html$")
figures    <- find_files("figures", "\\.(png|jpe?g|svg)$")
```

:root[data-theme="dark"] .viz-root {
  color-scheme: dark;

.viz-root { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

.tile-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
}
.tile {
  background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}
.tile .label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.tile .value {
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  color: var(--text-primary);   /* value wears ink, never a series colour */
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.tile .sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }

.stage-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 1rem 0;
}
.stage {
  background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
/* Status is never colour alone: every chip carries a glyph and a text label. */
.dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.dot.ran     { background: var(--good); }
.dot.skipped { background: var(--muted-fill); }
.stage .name { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.stage .state { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.78rem; }

.gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}
.gallery figure {
  margin: 0; background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px;
}
.gallery img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; border-radius: 4px; }
.gallery figcaption {
  font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: 6px; word-break: break-word;
}
.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
table { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }  /* columns must align vertically */
</style>

# `r params$project_name`

```{r headline, results = "asis"}
tile <- function(label, value, sub = "") {
  sprintf('<div class="tile"><div class="label">%s</div><div class="value">%s</div><div class="sub">%s</div></div>',
          label, value, sub)
}

n_reports <- length(reports)
n_figures <- length(figures)

dur <- "n/a"
if (!is.null(trace_file) && length(trace_file)) {
  tr <- tryCatch(fread(trace_file[1]), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(tr) && "realtime" %in% names(tr)) {
    # trace realtime is milliseconds
    total_h <- suppressWarnings(sum(as.numeric(tr$realtime), na.rm = TRUE) / 3.6e6)
    if (is.finite(total_h)) dur <- sprintf("%.1f h", total_h)
  }
}

cat('<div class="tile-row">')
cat(tile("Pipeline",   if (!is.null(manifest)) manifest$version else "SCRATCH-E2E", "version"))
cat(tile("NMF engine", if (!is.null(manifest)) manifest$nmf_engine else "n/a", "metaprogram factorisation"))
cat(tile("Stage reports", n_reports, "rendered notebooks"))
cat(tile("Figures",    n_figures, "published"))
cat(tile("Compute",    dur, "summed task runtime"))
cat('</div>')
```

## Stages

```{r stages, results = "asis"}
# A stage counts as having run if it published at least one report or figure.
stage_names <- c("align", "qc", "cluster", "annotation", "batchcorrection",
                 "cnv", "metaprog", "trajectory", "cellcomm", "tcr", "integration")

all_paths <- c(reports, figures)
ran <- vapply(stage_names, function(s) any(grepl(s, all_paths, fixed = TRUE)), logical(1))

cat('<div class="stage-grid">')
for (i in seq_along(stage_names)) {
  cls   <- if (ran[i]) "ran" else "skipped"
  glyph <- if (ran[i]) "&#10003;" else "&#8211;"      # check / en-dash, not colour alone
  state <- if (ran[i]) "ran" else "not run"
  cat(sprintf('<div class="stage"><span class="dot %s"></span><span><span class="name">%s %s</span><br><span class="state">%s</span></span></div>',
              cls, glyph, stage_names[i], state))
}
cat('</div>')
```

## Cross-stage findings

```{r cross, results = "asis"}
if (length(cross_csv)) {
  for (f in sort(cross_csv)) {
    dt <- tryCatch(fread(f), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next
    cat("\n\n### ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
    print(kable(head(dt, 25), format = "html"))
    cat('</div>')
    if (nrow(dt) > 25) cat(sprintf("\n\n_Showing 25 of %d rows._\n", nrow(dt)))
  }
} else {
  cat("\n_No cross-stage tables were produced. The integration stage needs at least two analysis stages to have run._\n")
}
```

## Figures

```{r gallery, results = "asis"}
if (length(figures)) {
  cat('<div class="gallery">')
  for (f in sort(figures)) {
    # Embed as data URI so the report stays self-contained when copied.
    mime <- switch(tolower(tools::file_ext(f)),
                   png = "image/png", svg = "image/svg+xml",
                   jpg = "image/jpeg", jpeg = "image/jpeg", "image/png")
    uri <- tryCatch(
      paste0("data:", mime, ";base64,", base64enc::base64encode(f)),
      error = function(e) f
    )
    cat(sprintf('<figure><img src="%s" alt="%s"><figcaption>%s</figcaption></figure>',
                uri, basename(f), basename(f)))
  }
  cat('</div>')
} else {
  cat("\n_No figures were published._\n")
}
```

## Per-stage reports

```{r report-index, results = "asis"}
if (length(reports)) {
  idx <- data.table(report = basename(reports),
                    stage  = basename(dirname(reports)),
                    link   = sprintf('<a href="stages/%s">open</a>', basename(reports)))
  setorder(idx, stage, report)
  cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
  print(kable(idx, format = "html", escape = FALSE))
  cat('</div>')
  cat("\n\n_Each stage's full notebook is copied alongside this file under `stages/`._\n")
} else {
  cat("\n_No stage reports were found._\n")
}
```

## Run provenance

```{r provenance, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(manifest)) {
  flat <- data.table(field = names(manifest),
                     value = vapply(manifest, function(v) paste(as.character(v), collapse = ", "), character(1)))
  cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
  print(kable(flat, format = "html"))
  cat('</div>')
} else {
  cat("\n_No run manifest available._\n")
}
```

### Resource usage

```{r resources, results = "asis"}
if (length(trace_file)) {
  tr <- tryCatch(fread(trace_file[1]), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(tr) && nrow(tr) && "process" %in% names(tr)) {
    keep <- intersect(c("process", "status", "duration", "realtime", "peak_rss", "cpus", "attempt"), names(tr))
    summ <- tr[, .(tasks = .N), by = process][order(-tasks)]
    cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
    print(kable(summ, format = "html"))
    cat('</div>')
  }
} else {
  cat("\n_No trace file was captured._\n")
}
```
